PROJECT OVERVIEW

What it sets out to do.

A question inbox built around sharing a personal link, collecting questions, and replying. The product work includes account flow, private inbox, and social sharing.

What I focused on

Keeping the ask flow short, making shared links understandable, and giving the owner a clear place to manage replies.

THE BUILD

The thinking behind the page.

A useful project has to connect its interface to the visitor’s task.

Audience

People who need a clear path into Hushly and an interface they can understand quickly.

Experience

Keeping the ask flow short, making shared links understandable, and giving the owner a clear place to manage replies.

Next iteration

Review real visitor feedback and refine the areas where people hesitate or need more context.

Interface decisions

A personal link is the entry point, so the page has to make the recipient and the next action immediately clear. After submission, the account owner needs a readable inbox and a reliable path to reply.

What I would keep refining

This kind of product lives in shared social links. I pay particular attention to narrow screens, signup friction, message states and the language around privacy.
